title: Create an Outlook calendar event with AI
h1: put an agreed appointment on your outlook calendar with ai
description: Create Outlook calendar events with a bot. Give the subject, start, end and time zone, then review the calendar and attendee list before any change.
keyword: create outlook calendar event with ai
answer: a bot can create an outlook calendar event from your subject, start, end and time zone. you can also specify a calendar, location, attendees or recurrence. if you don't name a calendar, it uses your main calendar. event creation is classified as a write, so the sending setting will not pause it for review. tell the bot to ask before creating anything when the details need your confirmation.
og_line: an agreed time, on the intended calendar.
what:
turn an agreed appointment into a calendar entry by giving the bot its title and concrete dates. the start must precede the end, and the time zone is required. name the calendar you want; if you don't, it goes on your main calendar.

optional details include body text, a physical location, categories, availability status and a repeating pattern. the online-meeting option can generate a teams link when the supported teams provider is specified. those options need deliberate instructions rather than guesses from the title.
uses: reserve a personal appointment on the calendar you name
add a confirmed site visit with its street address and travel notes
create an agreed recurring office-hours slot with a defined end to the pattern
set up a teams appointment using the requested online meeting option

routine.message: on the last tuesday of each month at 16:40, prepare a personal stockroom inspection for the first thursday of the next month from 15:00 to 15:30 in europe/paris. list my outlook calendars and confirm the one named field visits, then show the subject, dates, location and no-attendee list here. ask me before you change anything and return the event details here only after i approve creation. never use the default calendar as a fallback, add attendees or create a duplicate inspection if one is already present.
routine.when: last tuesday of the month at 16:40
routine.needs: outlook connected with read and write calendar access; calendar listing, event reading and event creation allowed
routine.output:
event proposal for field visits

subject: stockroom inspection
when: 3 december 2026, 15:00-15:30, europe/paris
location: east stockroom
attendees: none, personal calendar entry only

awaiting your approval before creation.

steps: connect outlook under **Connected apps** and allow the bot **read and write** for the calendar actions it needs.
have it list calendars and read back the intended destination, plus the full start, end and time zone.
include an explicit ask-before-creating instruction, especially when attendees or recurring dates are part of the request.
check an approved test event in outlook and use **Pause** on its routine card if the inspection plan changes.
watch: if you don't name a calendar, the event goes on your main one.
an all-day event requires midnight start and end values in the same time zone. a timed appointment should not be marked all day by mistake.
say the time zone with the time ("3pm paris time") and check it in the preview.
this action creates an entry; its inputs do not include a conflict-checking step. ask the bot to inspect existing events separately before proposing a time.

faq.q: will it ask me before adding a meeting?
faq.a: not automatically under the sending setting. calendar creation is a write, so put the request to ask first into your message or routine.

faq.q: can it create a teams meeting link?
faq.a: the action supports an online meeting flag and the teams for business provider. request both when that is the meeting type you want.

faq.q: can i choose how the time appears to others?
faq.a: you can specify an availability status such as busy, free, tentative or out of office. tell the bot which one fits instead of assuming every appointment should block your time.
